_README: gsc_property: the exact Search Console siteUrl. null = no access yet, in
which case NO client email is sent and an internal notice goes to Yasir
instead. Never invent figures for a site we cannot measure.
client_email: who receives the report. null = internal only.
send_to_client: master switch per site. Set false to hold a site back
gsc_property may be a domain property (sc-domain:example.com) or a URL-prefix property (https://example.com/). Domain properties are preferred - they cover every subdomain and both protocols.
cc_extra: optional extra recipients for one site, added on top of the global cc. Everything IT uses it for the standing rule that a director is always copied.

require_approval: true = client-facing reports are queued for Yasir's Approve/Hold instead of being sent straight to the client. Set to false once he is happy the reports go out correctly on their own. Internal copies to ceo@ are never queued.
